user.title: Red Energy Setup
user.description: How do you sign in to Red Energy?

menu_options.browser: Google, Apple, Microsoft or emailed code

browser.title: Sign in with your browser
browser.description:
Use a desktop browser (Chrome or Edge) - on a phone with the Red Energy app installed, the app intercepts the sign-in.

1. [Open the Red Energy sign-in page]({auth_url}).
2. On that page, press F12 to open the developer tools, select the **Network** tab and tick **Preserve log**.
3. Sign in with Google, Apple, Microsoft or an emailed code. The page won't change afterwards.
4. In the Network list, select the last request with status **302**. Under **Headers → Response Headers**, copy the **location** value - it starts `au.com.redenergy://callback?code=`.
5. Paste it below **straight away** - it expires quickly.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Red Energy. Check your internet connection.
error.no_accounts: No Red Energy accounts found for this user
error.invalid_callback: That isn't the callback URL from this sign-in. Copy the full location value starting au.com.redenergy://callback?code= after signing in with the link above.
error.callback_expired: That sign-in code has expired. Open the sign-in link again and paste the new callback URL straight away.
error.browser_sign_in_failed: Red Energy sign-in didn't complete (for example it was cancelled or denied). Open the sign-in link and try again.

abort.already_configured: Red Energy account is already configured
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Red Energy. Check your internet connection.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in to Red Energy again successfully
abort.wrong_account: You signed in as a different Red Energy customer than this integration was set up with.
